experiment: P11 hidden prompt full-policy net-benefit validation
trigger: FAQ Q4 states exactly three prompt IDs exist and their correction values are hidden; agents must learn from node feedback

arms.p11: actual prompt-learning runtime; complete prompt 1/2/3 probe on the first public low-impact node, stop after one node when provisional_prompt_ids is nonempty, otherwise probe at most one second node; then use best_or_default; total probe cost 6 or at most 12
arms.p9_no_probe: unchanged starnet-p9-bounded-response-20260913.zip; no calibration actions or matched probe cost
arms.fixed1_online_magnitude_no_probe: diagnostic arm; no dedicated calibration probes and never changes prompt ID from 1, but updates population response magnitude from ordinary public prompt-1 returns under the experimental planner
arms.known_best_id_p9_reference: diagnostic deployable reference if the best ID were known: run the actual P9 controller and map each legal prompt-1 environment dispatch to the true best prompt ID; subsequent public feedback may change P9 target selection, while prompt strengths and response factors remain hidden from the controller; this is not a mathematical upper bound or an optimal-policy oracle

development.case_status: all graph/response seeds were consumed previously; prompt maps are an explicit new factor, not a holdout
development.graph_response_blocks: six legacy repetition-1 seeds plus P9 four resampled families repetition 901 under centered_independent and negative_persona_aligned, total 14
development.prompt_maps: all six ID permutations of every amplitude family

fresh_confirmation_reserved.core_design: all six permutations crossed with every graph/repetition/response block, 288 cases
fresh_confirmation_reserved.edge_design: 48 additional cases assigned before generation: 12 each per edge regime across the 24 graph/response blocks and balanced prompt IDs

edge_regimes.all_negative: all six permutations of [-2,-6,-11] across assigned blocks
edge_regimes.clip: all six permutations of [90,20,-10] across assigned blocks

fresh_confirmation_reserved.degree_stress_queue: four families at repetition 1401 under degree-correlated response, medium amplitude [18,8,-7], all six prompt permutations; 24 cases
fresh_confirmation_reserved.status: reserved and generator-closed until development winner and canonical runtime/source hashes are frozen; do not use P10 1201-1203 or guarded 1301-1303

primary_estimand: P11 minus unchanged P9, averaged first across the six prompt permutations within graph/amplitude blocks and then equally across graph/repetition blocks; permutation siblings remain together in bootstrap resampling
mock_scope: matrix constructs the real CaseVO model/controller but injects a strict valid controller ranker for deterministic paired choices, bypassing Prompt transport; separate real-entry checks must cover Prompt and AgentBase routing
bootstrap_blocks: development has 10 topology blocks (six legacy plus four P9 family/repetition graphs); confirmation has 12 fresh family/repetition graph blocks; response-stratum, amplitude, permutation and edge siblings sharing topology/opinions always move together
number_symmetry: each unique amplitude family represents every best prompt ID equally; report per-best-ID means but do not require every group to be nonnegative
exploration_cost_gate: on unique-best cases where prompt 1 is already best, mean P9-minus-P11 cost must be no greater than max(5 terminal units, 25 percent of P9 mean oracle regret where prompt 1 is not best)
known_id_gap_gate: on unique-best cases, P11 mean signed gap to the known-best-ID P9 reference must be at most 40 percent of P9 mean signed gap; if the P9 mean gap is nonpositive the gate fails instead of dividing by a negative denominator
development_gate: all 252 cases complete with zero action, planning, calibration, resource or identity failures
unique-best prompt identification is correct whenever the public probe is informative and uncensored
permutation-symmetric mean P11-minus-P9 is positive and graph-block bootstrap 95 percent lower endpoint is strictly positive
exploration cost and known-best-ID signed-gap gates pass
standard base-amplitude prompt-1-best degradation is reported explicitly
edge behavior is not inferred from unique-best development and requires the reserved confirmation
confirmation_gate: all 360 cases complete with zero action, planning, calibration, resource or identity failures
the 288 core cases have positive permutation-symmetric mean P11-minus-P9 and a 12-graph-block bootstrap 95 percent lower endpoint strictly positive
the complete prespecified 336 core-plus-edge case mean P11-minus-P9 including tie, zero, all-negative and clipping diagnostics is positive
the separate 24-case degree-correlated stress queue mean P11-minus-P9 is nonnegative
exploration cost and known-best-ID signed-gap gates pass on unique-best core cases
report each edge-regime mean and loss list without requiring every tie/zero/negative/clip group to be nonnegative
at least two topology-family core means are positive and prompt-ID identification remains numbering symmetric
canonical runtime/source/archive hashes and real-entry validation pass
